([[Montverde, Florida]]) | college = [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] (2019–2020) | highlights = * [[American Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|AAC Player of the Year]] (2020) * [[American Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year|AAC Freshman of the Year]] (2020) * First-team All-[[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] (2020) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2019 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2019]]) * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2019) | medal_templates = }} '''Precious Achiuwa''' (born September 19, 1999) is a Nigerian [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis Tigers]]. He finished his high school career at [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]] and was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]]. ==Early life and high school career== Achiuwa was born in [[Port Harcourt]], Nigeria and grew up mainly playing [[association football|soccer]].{{cite web |last1=Tomes |first1=Evan |title=Precious Achiuwa Interview |url=https://www.nbadraft.net/precious-achiuwa-interview |publisher=NBADraft.net |accessdate=July 28, 2019 |date=April 12, 2019}} He started focusing on [[basketball]] while in eighth grade, which is when he moved to the United States.{{cite web |last1=Bedore |first1=Gary |title=Precious Achiuwa, who is on KU’s wish list, says ‘stay tuned’ for weekend decision |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article230369774.html |website=[[The Kansas City Star]] |accessdate=July 28, 2019 |date=May 14, 2019}} As a high school freshman, Achiuwa played basketball for Our Saviour Lutheran School in [[The Bronx]], New York.{{cite web |last1=Munz |first1=Jason |title=Memphis basketball: A closer look at Precious Achiuwa's unconventional recruitment |url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/college/memphis-tigers/basketball/2019/07/08/memphis-basketball-precious-achiuwa-penny-hardaway-tigers-wiseman/1498713001/ |website=[[The Commercial Appeal]] |accessdate=July 28, 2019 |date=July 8, 2019}} For his next two years, he attended [[St. Benedict's Preparatory School]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]]. The school had a nationally ranked basketball program and he was teammates with several [[NCAA Division I]] recruits.{{cite web |last1=Riedel |first1=Kenny |title=The Slam Dunk skinny on prime-time basketball |url=https://www.capegazette.com/article/slam-dunk-skinny-prime-time-basketball/122650 |website=[[Cape Gazette]] |accessdate=July 28, 2019 |date=December 26, 2016}} In his junior season, Achiuwa averaged 18.5 points, 10.5 rebounds, 2.9 blocks, and 2.2 steals per game, leading his team to a 28–2 record. He was named to the [[MaxPreps]] Junior All-American second team.{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=2017-18 MaxPreps Boys Basketball Junior All-American Team |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/hNi1UD2amUag_PSRxexoDw/2017-18-maxpreps-boys-basketball-junior-all-american-team-.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=April 13, 2018}} Entering his senior year, Achiuwa transferred to [[Montverde Academy]], a prep school in [[Montverde, Florida]] with a successful basketball program that held the No. 1 national ranking in the previous season.{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Cam |title=Chosen 25 F Precious Achiuwa transfers to Montverde Academy from St. Benedict's |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2018/chosen-25-f-precious-achiuwa-transfers-to-montverde-academy-from-st-benedicts |website=USA Today High School Sports |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=August 14, 2018}} He led Montverde with 14 points and 7.2 rebounds per game and helped his team reach the semifinals at [[High School Showcase|GEICO High School Nationals]].{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=GEICO Nationals: No. 4 IMG Academy (Fla.) stages epic comeback to knockoff No. 3 Montverde (Fla.) Academy |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/geico-nationals-no-4-img-academy-fla-stages-epic-comeback-to-knockoff-no-3-montverde-fla-academy |website=USA Today High School Sports |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=April 5, 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=MaxPreps 2018-19 High School Boys Basketball All-American Team |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/mdbwDYCSa02E7-TpRc5Gmg/maxpreps-2018-19-high-school-boys-basketball-all-american-team.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=April 11, 2019}} Achiuwa earned MaxPreps All-American fifth team, ''[[USA Today]]'' All-USA third team, and ''USA Today'' All-USA Florida first team honors.{{cite web |title=2018-19 ALL-USA High School Boys Basketball: Third Team |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/2018-19-all-usa-high-school-boys-basketball-third-team |website=USA Today High School Sports |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=April 2, 2019}}{{cite web |title=2018-19 ALL-USA Florida Boys Basketball Team |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/2018-19-all-usa-florida-boys-basketball-team |website=USA Today High School Sports |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=April 16, 2019}} On March 27, 2019, he played for the East team in the [[2019 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]], leading all scorers with 22 points.{{cite web |title=Precious Achiuwa Shines at McDonald's All-American Game |url=https://mvasports.com/news/2019/3/28/boys-basketball-precious-achiuwa-shines-at-mcdonalds-all-american-game.aspx |publisher=[[Montverde Academy]] |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=March 28, 2019}} On April 12, Achiuwa joined the World team at the [[Nike Hoop Summit]].{{cite web |last1=Lundeberg |first1=Bob |title=Nike Hoop Summit 2019: Internet sensation Nico Mannion sure to turn heads for World Team |url=https://www.oregonlive.com/highschoolsports/2019/04/nike-hoop-summit-2019-internet-sensation-nico-mannion-sure-to-turn-heads-for-world-team.html |website=[[The Oregonian]] |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=April 11, 2019}} ===Recruiting=== On May 17, 2019, Achiuwa committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] under head coach [[Penny Hardaway]]. He joined his former [[Amateur Athletic Union]] (AAU) teammate, Lester Quinones, and the number one player in the 2019 class, [[James Wiseman (basketball)|James Wiseman]].{{cite web |last1=Fowler |first1=Christian |title=Five-star forward Precious Achiuwa commits to Memphis |url=https://247sports.com/college/memphis/Article/Five-star-forward-Precious-Achiuwa-commits-to-Memphis--131979337/ |publisher=[[247Sports.com]] |accessdate=July 29, 2019 |date=May 17, 2019}} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2019}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Precious Achiuwa | position = [[Power forward (basketball)|PF]] | hometown = [[Queens|Queens, NY]] | highschool = [[Montverde Academy]] (FL) | feet = 6 | inches = 8 | weight = 210 | 40 = | commitdate = May 17, 2019 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 95 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2019 | rivals ref title = Memphis 2019 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2019 Memphis Tigers Recruiting Class | rivals school = memphis | scout s = | espn schoolid = 235 | 247 overall = 9 | rivals overall = 17 | espn overall = 17 | accessdate = May 17, 2019 | bball = yes }} ==College career== In his debut for Memphis, Achiuwa had 14 points and eight rebounds as the Tigers defeated [[South Carolina State Bulldogs men's basketball|South Carolina State]] 97–64.{{cite news |title=Wiseman has 28 and 11 in winning debut for No. 14 Memphis |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401170001 |accessdate=November 6, 2019 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 5, 2019}} Achiuwa scored a season-high 25 points in a 87–86 win over [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Ole Miss]] on November 23. As a result, he was named [[American Athletic Conference]] player of the week on November 25.{{cite web|url=http://theamerican.org/news/2019/11/25/memphis-achiuwa-uconns-bouknight-earn-mens-basketball-weekly-honors.aspx |title=Memphis' Achiuwa, UConn's Bouknight Earn Men's Basketball Weekly Honors|website=American Athletic Conference|date=November 25, 2019|accessdate=January 3, 2019}} He earned conference freshman of the week honors on December 23 after recording 20 points and nine rebounds in a 77–49 victory over [[Jackson State Tigers basketball|Jackson State]].{{cite web|url=http://theamerican.org/news/2019/12/23/ecus-gardner-memphis-achiuwa-earn-mens-basketball-weekly-honors.aspx |title=ECU's Gardner, Memphis' Achiuwa Earn Men's Basketball Weekly Honors|website=American Athletic Conference|date=December 23, 2019|accessdate=January 3, 2019}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Achiuwa was named AAC Player and Freshman of the Year.{{cite press release|url=https://theamerican.org/news/2020/3/11/mens-basketball-american-athletic-conference-announces-individual-awards.aspx|title=American Athletic Conference Announces Individual Awards|publisher=[[American Athletic Conference]]|date=March 11, 2020 |accessdate=March 11, 2020}} He averaged 15.8 points, 10.8 rebounds and 1.9 blocks per game as a freshman.{{cite news |last1=Collings |first1=Buddy |title=Orlando area college basketball All Stars for 2019-20 |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/sports/highschool/boys-basketball/os-sp-hs-college-basketball-best-20200401-ua7uhgocpnhzpow3j52az7y2su-story.html |accessdate=April 4, 2020 |work=[[Orlando Sentinel]] |date=April 3, 2020}} He declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]] after his freshman season.{{cite web |last1=Giviony |first1=Jonathan |title=Memphis star, AAC Player of the Year Precious Achiuwa to enter NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/29094379/memphis-star-aac-player-year-precious-achiuwa-enter-nba-draft%3fplatform=amp |website=espn.com |accessdate=24 April 2020}}
